description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Ardent Elementalist
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Ardent Elementalist
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
